## Claims
- [source-backed] RWY Theorem 4.8, integrally in \(\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\), gives both right- and lower-adjoined generating families for \(J_v\), with \(a=\min(n-r-i,r-j)\), \(b=\min(i,j)\). [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 864-892]
- [source-backed] St. Dizier–Yong formulate Littlewood–Richardson coefficient linear systems under \(r<n\), \(a+j\le r\), \(a+i\le n-r\), \(b\le i,j\), and define “valid” tuples by these conditions plus \(N\le ab\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 270-303]
- [source-backed] Their Algorithm 1 repeatedly applies a coproduct-based reduction to tensors representing those linear forms; it terminates because nontrivial updates strictly lower the degree of the left tensor factor. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 494-516; 598-610]
- [source-backed] The resulting argument proves tall linear forms lie in the \(\mathbb Z\)-span of wide forms in the bounded-\(N\) regime, then proves inconsistency of the relevant syzygy system. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 743-775; 790-826]
- [proved] Assuming the project notation \(p=(n-r)-i\) and \(c=r-j\), the \((i,j,p,c)=(2,2,4,4)\) case corresponds to \(n=12,r=6,i=j=2\), hence \(a=4\) and \(b=2\); it satisfies the cited validity inequalities.

## Strategy
The inspected full texts were RWY (2011) and St. Dizier–Yong (arXiv:2209.02011 / 2024). The latter supplies a general integral LR-linear-system reduction algorithm relevant to the specialized parameters, but it is not a degreewise Pieri-matrix algorithm: its objects are \(\operatorname{Lin}_\varphi(\nu)\), coproduct tensors, and tall/wide relations.

Neither inspected source states Smith normal forms, explicitly indexed complementary column sets, unimodular complementary minors, or a sparse block elimination certifying Smith data for the \((2,2,4,4)\) Pieri matrices.

## Gaps
The requested target is **not established** by this literature search. The cited algorithm may suggest a reduction ordering, but no inspected source supplies the required degreewise block construction or the demanded minor/SNF certificates. This is a bounded negative result for the inspected sources, not a universal claim about all literature.

## Next
A task-owned exact Pieri computation or a new direct proof must construct and verify the complementary unimodular minors degree by degree.
